waves.name: wave-1-webresearch
waves.prompt: Use your web tools (wigolo MCP: search, fetch, extract) to find the latest published version of the npm package 'wigolo' and its source repository URL. Report the version, the repo URL, and cite at least 2 source URLs you actually fetched. IMPORTANT: if you have no working web/MCP tools, reply with exactly this text and nothing else: WEB-TOOLS-UNAVAILABLE
waves.done_when: reports version + repo URL with at least 2 cited source URLs (or the literal WEB-TOOLS-UNAVAILABLE signal)
